fixer.title: agentHost: don't block session open on Copilot Connector reconciliation

introducer.title: agentHost: reconcile Copilot Connectors in place

cases.mechanism: _finalizeSession synchronously awaited connectors.reconcile on every Connector-enabled create/resume; that RPC restarts Connector MCP servers and does not resolve until their remote MCP initialization handshakes finish.
cases.symptom: Opening or resuming a Connector-enabled session was blocked on multi-second remote Connector server initialization before the session wrapper could be returned.
cases.fixedBehavior: The changed line starts the same reconciliation but adopts its promise into the session without awaiting it in _finalizeSession, removing the remote handshake from session-open's critical path while later Connector-dependent operations remain ordered behind it.
cases.evidence: The deleted base line awaited reconcileCopilotConnectors inside _finalizeSession before wrapper construction/return. reconcileCopilotConnectors crosses connectors capability/account RPCs and connectors.reconcile; the changed code's own launch-path comment identifies the latter as restarting Connector MCP servers and resolving only after remote handshakes that take seconds. The replacement at line 1080 hands the promise to runtime.adoptLaunchConnectorReconcile and immediately proceeds to return the wrapper, directly removing that wait from create/resume latency.
